run.title: Night One · The Watch
run.body:
The raid is coming.
Auto-strike, loose arrows, fire the hand cannon, and keep the lamp beyond Yongchang.

select.fiction_note: The main story has one protagonist: the fictional lamp-watch defender Wang Lu / A-Liu. These six cards are his weapon-and-footwork posts, not six separate people. Tang He appears only in the 1386 prologue.
